questions.q_en: Sum of two numbers is 381 and difference between them is 135. Find the larger number.
questions.solution_en:
Let the numbers be a and b

a + b = 381..........(i)

a - b = 135.........(ii)

from (ii)

a = 135 + b

Putting value of a in (i) we get,

135 + b + b = 381

2b = 246

b = 123

a = 135 + 123 = 258

questions.q_en: In a 1500-meter city marathon, Runner P finishes the race 240 meters ahead of Runner Q, or 8 seconds faster. What is the product of their speeds (in meters per second)?
questions.solution_en:
When P covers 1500 m Q covers 1260 m

Also, Q covers 240 m in 8 seconds

So, the speed of Q = 240/8 = 30 m/sec

Time taken by Q to cover 1260 m = 1260/ 30 = 42 seconds

Speed of P = 1500/42 = 250/7 m/s

Hence, the product of the speeds of P and Q = (250 x 30/7) = 7500/7 m/sec

questions.q_en: The largest four-digit number which is exactly divisible by each one of the numbers 15, 25, 90 and 125.

Factor of 25 = 5 * 5

Factor of 125 = 53

LCM = 32 * 53 * 2 = 2250

Largest 4 - digit number = 9999

9999 ÷ 2250 = 4 remainder 999

Required number = 9999 - 999 = 9000

questions.q_en: Curved surface area of a solid hemisphere is 256π cm2 less than its total surface area. If the diameter of the hemisphere is increased by 4 cm, then its volume (in cm3) will be -
questions.solution_en:
Let radius of solid hemisphere = r cm

Then, total surface area of hemisphere - curved surface area of hemisphere = 256π

3πr2 - 2πr2 = 256π

r2 = 256

r = 16

New radius of hemisphere = 16 + 4/2 = 18 cm

Therefore, volume of hemisphere = 2/3 * π * (new radius of hemisphere)3

= 2/3 * π * (18)3

= 3888π cm3

questions.q_en: What is the unit digit of 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545?
questions.solution_en:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values
Power 1Power 2Power 3Power 4
010
111
242486
343971
4246
515
616
747931
848426
9291

(Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In the given series 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545, we can see that power of every next term is increased by 4 than power of previous number and from cyclicity table, we can see the cyclicity of numbers from 0 to 9.

Now, from cyclicity, we know unit digit of 5th power of 5 will be 5, 9th power of 6 will be 6 and so on.

Then, unit digit of 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545 = unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15)

In the above series,

First term = 5 = a

Last term = 15 = an

Common difference = d = 6 - 5 = 1

Then, an = a + (n - 1)d

15 = 5 + (n - 1) x 1

n = 11

Then, unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15)

= unit digit of (n/2)(a + an)

= unit digit of (11/2)(5 + 15)

= unit digit of 110

= 0

The area of the circular park is 18634 m2. The path around this circular park has width 7 m. Find the area of circular path thus formed?
questions.solution_en:
Area of circular park = 18364 m2

Area of circle = πr2

Therefore, πr2 = 18634

r = 11 X 7 = 77 m

Area of circular path = π[(r+7)2 - r2)]

= π[(77+7)2 - 772)]

= π(842 - 772)

= π(7056 - 5929)

= (22 X 1127)/7 = 161 X 22 = 3542 m2

questions.q_en: The external radius of a cylindrical pipe is 12 cm and thickness of the pipe is 1/6th of external radius. If height of pipe is 9 cm more than its internal radius then, the volume of pipe is: (Rounded off to one decimal place)
questions.solution_en:
External radius of pipe (R) = 12 cm

Thickness of pipe = 12/6 = 2 cm

Internal radius of pipe (r) = 12 - 2 = 10 cm

Height of pipe (H) = 10 + 9 = 19 cm

Volume of pipe = π * (R2 - r2) * H

= (22/7) * (144 - 100) * 19

= (22/7) * 44 * 19

= 2627.4 cm3

River speed (against current) = 1/(13/60) = 60/13 km/h

River speed = 5 - 60/13 = 5/13 km/h
